question: Can closed-form q(t) be implemented via the Path 2 precession+nutation decomposition, round-tripping cached truth at machine precision?
hypothesis: The Path 2 (precession + nutation) closed-form q(t) reconstructs the propagator's trajectory under standard right-handed conventions.
narrative_md: Path 2 closed-form q(t) attempted (precession+nutation 3-1-3 decomposition) but hit a convention puzzle: q-interpretation matches the propagator at t=0 (1e-16) yet the reconstruction drifts at t>0, and L_J2000 = R.T @ L_body is not conserved even on a toy asymmetric tumbler. Path 2 deferred; production reverted to the HYBRID path (closed-form omega + DOP853 q-ODE) which passes 2T/L^2 conservation strict 1e-12 and matches DOP853 to integration noise (1e-10 to 1.6e-8). The puzzle was later resolved by s065/s066 (omega-sign convention residual / L_J2000 non-conservation). Validates against cohort truth (render-at-truth).
